fields.description: Issue dated January 1, 1949. Includes editorials and local commentary on taxation and government spending; labor conflict involving the Miami Herald and newspaper unions; advocacy for municipal ownership of electric utilities and criticism of Florida Power & Light; concerns about Biscayne Bay dredge-and-fill permits and sale of bay bottom lands; public health reporting on Florida infant mortality and premature births; and coverage of a Miami Beach divorce case alleging fraud involving Joseph E. Jacobson. Also contains local society/civic notes (including an honor for Miami Life publisher Reubin Clein by the Catholic Unity Party), entertainment items, and extensive classified/business advertising.
